option_text:
OPTION 1: S3 + CloudFront (Standard Setup)
RECOMMENDED
Best for: Static websites with global users, simple to manage
Cost: $3-15/month (all 3 sites combined, depending on traffic)

Key points:
- S3 buckets (one per website) with static website hosting enabled
- CloudFront distributions for CDN/HTTPS delivery and low latency globally
- Route 53 for custom domain names (if needed)
- S3 storage: ~$0.35/month for 15GB total across 3 sites (at $0.023/GB)
- CloudFront: ~$0.85/GB data transfer (first 10TB), plus ~$0.0075 per 10,000 HTTPS requests
- Automatic scaling - handles traffic spikes without configuration
- HTTPS certificates via AWS Certificate Manager (free)
- Enable S3 versioning for rollback capability
- Block public access to S3, serve only through CloudFront for security

SOC 2 Compliance:
- Enable CloudTrail for access audit logs (addresses CC6.1)
- Use S3 SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS encryption at rest (addresses CC6.6, CC6.7)
- Implement CloudFront signed URLs if content needs access control
- Enable S3 access logging

Tradeoffs: Requires DNS setup per domain, but very low operational overhead. Best price/performance ratio.
